Sandbox_CustomizableClothing_Durability_: Removes durability loss from clothing equipped by the player.
Sandbox_CustomizableClothing_Degradation: Disables or removes clothing degradation effects such as holes, blood, and wetness.
Sandbox_CustomizableClothing_SatchelWear: Allows wearing a satchel with a backpack and fanny packs. The selected mode controls how many fanny packs can be worn with it.
Sandbox_CustomizableClothing_ChestRigWea: Chest Rig Wearable with Fanny Pack/Satchel
Allows wearing a chest rig with a fanny pack or satchel. Satchel support depends on the selected satchel wearable mode.
Sandbox_CustomizableClothing_ShoulderWea: Allows wearing left and right shoulder armor with a backpack.
Sandbox_CustomizableRecipes_CContainers_: Enables storage upgrade kits and upgrades for supported world storage sprites.

Controls the highest available upgrade tier for world storage sprites. Each option unlocks that tier and all previous tiers. Capacity depends on size class. Small: 50/125/250/375/500/1000/2500/5000. Medium: 75/200/375/500/750/1500/3750/7500. Large: 100/250/500/750/1000/2000/5000/10000.
Sandbox_CustomizableRecipes_CContainersD: Bypasses per-sprite size classes for world storage sprites. When enabled, all eligible containers use the large capacity table.
Sandbox_CustomizablePickUp_Limit_tooltip: Allows equipping extremely heavy backpacks. This only affects backpacks; other container types use different equip functions.
Sandbox_CustomizableRandomizer_RequireSt: When enabled, randomized container stats are hidden until revealed. To reveal the stats, drag the container into your inventory, right-click it, and select Reveal Stats.
